captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a highly customizable control knob featuring a cylindrical lower body and a smooth, domed cap. One side of the circular body is cut flat to provide a tactile orientation reference, while a small rectangular indicator bar projects from the opposite cylindrical wall. The top dome features a prominent, spherical finger-divot offset from the center to assist in quick rotation.
captions.instruction: Design a highly customizable control knob in OpenSCAD with adjustable parameters for height, diameter, and taper. It must support features like a flat tactile side, an external rectangular pointer, a domed cap, an offset spherical finger divot, and a D-shaped mounting hole with an optional setscrew hole.
captions.factory: The script constructs the knob using a boolean difference of a main union and several negative features. The main body is formed by a cylinder for the base, a scaled sphere for the dome cap, and a translated cube for the external pointer. Negative features subtracted from this main shape include a large cube to create the flat side, an offset sphere for the finger divot, a bottom cylinder for the D-shaped mounting hole (using a cylinder and a flat-sided cube), and a horizontal cylinder for the setscrew hole.
